summary: NewGenIvf Group Limited filed a routine Form 6-K confirming its total issued and outstanding class A ordinary shares stood at 27,287,002 as of the close of business on October 1, 2026. The share count reflects issuances under a best-efforts offering announced September 30, 2026, conversions of outstanding convertible promissory notes by certain holders, and shares issued under the Company's equity line of credit facility. No price per share, stake, premium, board recommendation, advisor, or transaction terms were disclosed. This is an ordinary foreign-private-issuer capital-structure update, not a special situation; watch future dilution from the equity line and note conversions.
